description: This file contains unit tests for the PyCodeCache class and cache mechanisms related to the inductor component of PyTorch, including cache loading, saving, cache hits/misses, and behavior with various configurations such as remote caching, inductor caches, and Triton kernels. It also includes tests for cache key uniqueness, tensor device guards, higher order kernels, and cache invalidations.

classes.name: TestPyCodeCache
classes.description: Contains unit tests for the PyCodeCache class, including cache writing, loading, and cache key behavior.

classes.name: TestFxGraphCache
classes.description: Contains comprehensive tests for caching behavior in the FX graph cache, including loading, saving, cache hits/misses, cache invalidation, device guards, higher order kernels, Triton kernels, and cache serialization.
